title: llp_forward reach study answer (scalars)
description: Deliverable schema for results/answer.json: the derived dimuon width formula and the width/lifetime probe scalars. The bulk yield scans N_sig(g) go in a separate flat table, results/scan.csv, with columns search, m_phi, g, nsig (one row per sampled coupling). The grader reconstructs the sensitivity band from that scan -- do not report a contour yourself.

width_formula_mumu.description: Closed form of Gamma(phi -> mu+ mu-) in the symbols g, m_phi, m_mu (and pi), e.g. using +, -, *, /, **, sqrt().

width_probe_gev.description: Gamma(phi -> mu+ mu-) in GeV at the declared dimuon width probe point.

width_gg_probe_gev.description: Gamma(phi -> gamma gamma) in GeV at the declared diphoton width probe point.

ctau_probe_m.description: c*tau in meters (TOTAL width) at the two declared lifetime probe points.
